item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi bzlog gzhung gser gyi spu gri
item.coloph: de ltar rkyen ngan bzlog (zlog) pa'i byang bu 'di/ phyi rabs don du tshe dbang bdag nyid kyi thugs bcud phyung ste las ldan gshen la rgyud (brgyud/)bka' 'di bon chos nyi zla 'char nub skabs/ lo pan d+ha ris bkod ste (de) bod yul phyogs/ zhang zhung sgo mo rtse drug lhun sgang rdzong gi/ byang nub zangs brag ri la gter du sbas/ phyis su nges med sprul sku gshed bzhi los/ zab mo gter gyi dbang skal rnyed par shog zhes (ces) gsungs stang chen la sogs grub pa'i gshen/ rig 'dzin du mas thugs la gces par bzung (zungs/)shog ser d+ha ris bkod nas rin chen brag la sbas/ bka' srung rnams la ma g.yel bka' dam bgos/ ji bzhin thugs bskyed smon lam zab mo gdab// phyis su sngon gyi smon lam dbang gi las dang rten 'brel 'tshogs te/ bdag 'dra gshen spral thugs rje nyi mas zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba'i mdun zhol tsi ta 'dra ba'i ngos nas sman dri bzang thul ler/ zab mo khrom gter du spyan drangs te/ lo mang bka' rgya sdom bsdoms/)slar mi dbang hor sras rin po che sogs / las ldan du mas thugs bzhed bskang phyir/ bkra shis lha steng gnas su bon 'chad pa'i thun 'dzams (mtshams) su/ shog ser bod yig du phab pa'o//
